answer: A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the signal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the fable of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
